subtitle: Utilities to help you get the most out of your Harbour Masters ports.

verification.title: Verify Your ROM
verification.description: Upload your ROM file to check compatibility with our ports. We do not distribute ROMs - you must use your own legally dumped copy.
verification.howToDump: How do I dump my own ROM? →
verification.dropZone: Drop your ROM file here or click to browse
verification.error: Failed to verify ROM. Please try again.
verification.noMatch: This ROM doesn't match any known version in our database.
verification.noMatchHint: Make sure you've dumped the correct ROM and it hasn't been modified.
verification.databaseSubtitle: Complete ROM database for all Harbour Masters ports. Click the hash icon to copy SHA-1.

audioTool.title: SoH Audio Tool
audioTool.subtitle: Convert WAV and OGG files to SoH sample format in your browser.
audioTool.dropZone: Drop audio files here or click to browse
audioTool.loopHint: Loop End = 0 uses last sample. Count = -1 means infinite.
audioTool.step1Subtitle: Required to browse and preview in-game audio samples.
audioTool.step1DropZone: Drop your .o2r file here or click to browse
audioTool.helpStep1: Load your Ship of Harkinian .o2r file — it contains the game's audio assets.
audioTool.helpStep2: Import your custom .wav or .ogg audio files.
audioTool.helpStep3: Select the in-game sample you want to replace from the combobox.
audioTool.helpStep4: Preview the original sample (from O2R) and your custom sample side by side.
audioTool.helpStep5: Adjust loop points using the waveform visualizer.
